experiments.procedure_text: BALB/c nude mice were injected with HuH7 cells subcutaneously to assess tumor growth or intravenously to assess lung metastasis.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: The xenograft mouse model was performed to investigate the tumorigenic ability of HCC in vivo. ... The metastatic model through the tail vein injection of HCC was established to measure metastatic ability in vivo.
experiments.test_system_evidence: The xenograft mouse model was performed to investigate the tumorigenic ability of HCC in vivo.
experiments.route_evidence: HuH7 cells were subcutaneously injected ... Nude mice were intravenously injected with 1 × 10 6 HuH7 cells.

endpoints.label: tumorigenesis
endpoints.evidence: investigate the tumorigenic ability of HCC in vivo

endpoints.label: tumor size and volume

experiments.exposure_evidence: Approximate 1 × 10 7 HuH7 cells were subcutaneously injected ... Nude mice were intravenously injected with 1 × 10 6 HuH7 cells.
